offer_summary: LienWaiver Desk is a done-for-you paperwork operator for subcontractors: pay apps, lien waivers, portal submissions, and follow-ups—so you get paid faster and stop losing time to rework.
included: Job setup: collect required forms + portal rules + contacts
Pay app packet assembly (cover sheet, SOV, invoice, backup docs as required)
Lien waiver prep (conditional/unconditional) using your job + invoice details
Document organization: standardized Drive folder structure
excluded: Legal advice or selection of state-specific waiver language (we can use your preferred templates)
Approving pricing, change orders, or disputed scope (you approve all numbers)
process: 15-min fit call: volume, portal types, waiver templates, and approval workflow
Onboarding (1–2 days): set up job templates + required docs checklist + folder structure
For each submission: you send invoice + job info → we assemble Pay App Pack → you approve → we submit
Follow-up loop: fix rejections, resubmit, and keep a paper trail
Weekly: send pending report + blockers + next actions
pricing_details: Starter: $499/mo (up to 8 submissions). Growth: $999/mo (up to 20). Pro: $1,499/mo (up to 40). Overages: $25/submission. One-time onboarding: $299 (waived for the first 3 pilot slots).
guarantee_line: Paperwork SLA: if we don’t submit within 24 business hours of receiving complete inputs, that submission is free.

faq.q: Do you need access to our accounting system?
faq.a: Not required. We can work from PDFs/CSVs and a shared Drive. If you want, we can use read-only exports from QuickBooks/Xero. We never need bank access.

faq.q: How do you handle security and sensitive financial docs?
faq.a: Least-privilege access (a single shared folder + portal login if needed), optional NDA, and a retention window (default: keep only what’s needed for active jobs).

faq.q: What’s required from us each time?
faq.a: Invoice amount + billing period, job name/number, and any required backup docs (timecards, receipts, photos) if your GC requires them. We’ll give you a one-page checklist per customer/portal.

faq.q: Do you choose the waiver type / language?
faq.a: We prepare the waiver using your preferred templates and the correct conditional/unconditional flow based on payment status, but we’re not your attorney. If your state/job has special language, we recommend attorney-reviewed templates.
Usually 60–90 minutes of your time and 1–2 business days to set up your first job template + folder structure.
We track rejection rate, average days from ‘invoice ready’ → ‘submitted’, and days-to-acceptance. The goal is fewer kickbacks and faster approvals.

trust_basics_line: Not legal advice. You approve all amounts and final submissions. We operate the workflow and keep the audit trail.
